items.title: Update 2.1.70

items.title: Halloween Livestream on Twitch
items.summary: Join us for a special Halloween livestream packed with spooky fun, surprises, laughs, and Pixel Worlds goodness! 🎃 We are giving away the exclusive Livestream Sign for lucky winners too! ​

items.title: Update 2.1.28
items.summary: - Added Legendary and Ultra Rare items change schedule to Event info and HALLOWEENCASTLE -world - Brought back setting email and username in client UI - A lot of other small fixes and improvements

items.title: Halloween update 2.1.24
items.summary: Halloween returns to Pixel Worlds! You voted, we listened! The Black Tower is back with rewards from both the 2017 & 2018 Halloween events, plus a few new surprises. * Gather Lost Souls and take on the Black Tower * Collect Candy and visit the Candy Demon, including the new 999 Candy Pumpkin Warrior Wings * Returning Community items are back based on your feedback, with the new Ravenfall Cloak available during Hal…

items.title: Secret Base is back!
items.summary: Take on the Secret Base with 3 difficulty levels, tougher enemies and different prize pools. Earn returning rewards, achievements, Cyber & Quantum Shards, community items and a brand-new Legendary+ reward! The first event starts September 3 and lasts for one week. Secret Base will then return on the first Thursday of every month.

items.title: Fishing Tournaments Return
items.summary: Baby Cup, Fisherman’s Cup, and Pro Cup return. Official announcement says they start November 20, 2026; an end date has not been published.

items.title: Black Friday
items.summary: Special deals and offers announced for November 23–30, 2026.

items.title: Returning Community Items
items.summary: The Halloween announcement says other returning Community items remain available until December 18, 2026. The announcement does not specify every item or whether all items share identical availability.

items.title: Secret Base
items.summary: Secret Base dijadwalkan kembali setiap Kamis pertama setiap bulan, berdasarkan pengumuman resmi 31 Agustus 2026. Jadwal berikutnya mengikuti pola rutin yang diumumkan; konfirmasi dalam game tetap disarankan.

items.title: Event Desember 2026 dan seterusnya (belum diumumkan)
items.summary: Belum ada tanggal resmi yang dapat diverifikasi untuk event musiman berikutnya seperti Christmas/New Year 2026–2027 atau event 2027. UGM akan menambahkannya saat diumumkan resmi.

items.title: Thanksgiving Event 2026
items.summary: Dipantau otomatis. Belum ditemukan pengumuman resmi Pixel Worlds yang mengonfirmasi event Thanksgiving 2026 atau tanggal pelaksanaannya. Status akan diperbarui jika Steam menerbitkan pengumuman.
